title: 第9章 开个小会
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

惠惠快步冲到船头，目光灼灼地凝视着远方海天相接的尽头，任凭海风将她的斗篷吹得猎猎作响。

她高举魔杖，以一种近乎咏叹的夸张语气开始吟唱：

“比太阳更炽热，比大海更深邃！沉睡在深渊尽头的红莲之炎啊，在此刻聆听吾之召唤！”

赤红色的魔力光芒开始汇聚，魔杖顶端的红光骤然膨胀，化作一个不断旋转的炽热法阵。

“吾乃红魔族首屈一指的大魔法师——惠惠！跨越世界的壁垒，踏足这片被诅咒的大海，吾将在此刻，于此地，刻下全新的传说！”

她的声音越来越高亢，整个人都笼罩在刺目的红光中。

“贯穿天际，焚尽万物，为这片漆黑的海洋带来终焉的审判——这就是究极的破坏魔法，这就是吾之生存之道！”

魔法阵爆发出一道冲天光柱，惠惠猛地将魔杖朝前一指，喊出了那个她期待已久的单词：

“Explosion！”

此刻的林北，正在船尾打捞此前投放的海上坐标。

那是一些系着铁球、瓶内塞了头发的漂流瓶。

忽然，惠惠的吟唱声从船头方向飘来，紧接着，天色骤变。

林北下意识挺直腰板，忽然想起了什么。

一个可怕的念头在脑海里闪过，瞳孔瞬间缩成针尖大小，冷汗唰地浸湿了后背。

下一秒，他连滚带爬地朝船头狂奔。

然而才跑到一半……

遥远的海面上，一朵巨大的蘑菇云冲天而起。

眼前先是一片刺目的白光，随即，所有的声音都被吞没了。

死寂过后，层层叠叠的冲击波裹挟着巨浪砸向船身。

整艘船像一叶扁舟在怒涛中剧烈摇摆，几近倾覆。

林北毫不犹豫扑向船舷，一把拉开锚闸，让铁锚狠狠咬进海底。

紧接着整个人死死匍匐在甲板上，双手紧扣着任何能抓住的东西，等待这场人为的天灾平息。

等海浪刚有舒缓，林北就强行起身，跌跌撞撞地在倾斜的甲板上艰难移动。

“悠悠！惠惠！你们还在吗？”

没有回应。

“悠悠！”

“惠惠！”

他的心猛地往下一沉。

直到冲到船头，林北才终于看清。

悠悠紧闭双眼，左手死死勾住船舷栏杆，右臂则紧紧扣住惠惠的腰肢，将其搂在怀里。

林北长长地松了一口气。

太好了，她们没事。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Megumin quickly rushed to the bow of the ship, staring with burning eyes at the far end where the sea and the sky met, letting the sea breeze blow her cloak.

She raised her wand high and began to sing in an exaggerated tone that was almost a chant:

"Hotter than the sun, deeper than the sea! The red lotus flame sleeping at the end of the abyss, listen to my call at this moment!"

The crimson magic light began to gather, and the red light at the top of the wand suddenly expanded, turning into a blazing magic circle that was constantly rotating.

"I am Megumin, the leading magician of the Crimson Demon Clan! Crossing the barriers of the world and setting foot on this cursed sea, I will carve a new legend at this moment and here!"

Her voice became louder and louder, and her whole body was enveloped in a dazzling red light.

"Penetrating through the sky, burning all things, and bringing final judgment to this dark ocean - this is the ultimate destructive magic, and this is my way of survival!"

The magic circle erupted into a beam of light that shot into the sky. Megumin pointed her wand forward and shouted the word she had been waiting for:

"Explosion!"

At this moment, Lin Bei was salvaging the previously released sea coordinates at the stern of the ship.

They were drift bottles with iron balls attached and hair stuffed inside.

Suddenly, Hui Hui's singing sound floated from the direction of the bow, and then, the sky suddenly changed.

Lin Bei straightened his back subconsciously and suddenly remembered something.

A terrible thought flashed through his mind, his pupils instantly shrank to the size of a pinhead, and cold sweat soaked his back.

The next second, he rolled and crawled towards the bow of the ship.

However, we were only halfway through...

On the distant sea, a huge mushroom cloud rose into the sky.

First there was a blinding white light in front of him, and then all the sounds were swallowed up.

After the deathly silence, layers of shock waves carried huge waves and crashed into the hull.

The whole ship was rocking violently in the roaring waves like a small boat, almost capsized.

Lin Bei did not hesitate to rush to the side of the ship, opened the anchor gate, and let the anchor bite into the seabed.

Immediately afterwards, the whole person was crawling on the deck, his hands clinging to anything he could grab, waiting for this man-made natural disaster to subside.

As soon as the waves subsided, Lin Bei forced himself to stand up and stumbled on the sloping deck.

"Yuyou! Huihui! Are you still there?"

No response.

"Yuyou!"

"Megumin!"

His heart sank suddenly.

It wasn't until he rushed to the bow of the ship that Lin Bei finally saw it clearly.

Youyou closed her eyes tightly, her left hand firmly hooked on the railing of the ship, and her right arm tightly clasped Megumin's waist, holding her in her arms.

Lin Bei breathed a long sigh of relief.

Great, they're fine.
